official_references.official_effect_text:
(This card is always treated as an "Elemental HERO" [b]and[/b] "Favorite" card.)
[b]Cannot[/b] be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand or GY) by banishing 1 "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster or 1 "Winged Kuriboh" from your hand, face-up field, or GY. [b]You can[/b] only Special Summon "Winged Kuriboh LV6" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b] this way. [b]When[/b] an opponent's monster declares an attack, or your opponent activates a monster effect on the field ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] Tribute this card; [b]destroy[/b] that 1 monster, [b]and if you do[/b], inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original ATK.

official_references.official_effect_text: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any Ritual Monster from your hand or GY. You must [b]also[/b] Tribute Machine monsters from your hand or field whose total ATK equal or exceed the ATK of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon. If this card is in your GY: [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 "Drytron" monster you control; it loses exactly 1000 ATK until the end of your opponent's turn, [b]and[/b] if it does, add this card to your hand. [b]You can[/b] only use this effect of "Meteonis Drytron" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].
